scope: Links to immutable prior validation, not newly executed render results. Source hashes force review after implementation edits.

native-render.scope: Native Cycles scene preparation and original GPU scheduler drive a repeated complete multi-bounce selected-material render through unchanged shipped WebGPU; full command replay on four GPUs

device-queue.scope: Registered Cycles device, scene uploads and wavefront control (control gate only)

camera-queue.scope: Registered Cycles camera entry through original GPU scheduler; static perspective pinhole, tabulated Sobol, ray differentials, sample counts and adaptive skip. Intersection/shading still pending.

closest-queue.scope: Original GPU scheduler camera -> native BVH2 closest -> background/surface/raytrace queues and shader sorting. Static triangles/instances, visibility/self-hit, AO and roulette decisions. Shading and forward lights remain pending.

background-queue.scope: Native scene -> original scheduler camera -> closest -> constant background -> film. Combined/transparency, background, lightgroups, diffuse/glossy/transmission direct/indirect, adaptive auxiliary and static background data passes. SVM worlds, sun/MIS and surface shading remain pending.

svm-world.scope: Native Cycles-compiled worlds -> original camera/closest/background scheduler -> typed SVM bytecode in WGSL -> native film. Selected world nodes only; surface/volume shader entries, image textures, derivatives and the remaining SVM nodes are pending.

svm-surface.scope: Selected surface SVM evaluation/setup from native scene tables and typed bytecode: diffuse, Oren-Nayar, translucent, transparent, emission, holdout and mixtures. Not BSDF sampling, a surface-bounce queue kernel or full session rendering.

replay-linux-x64-linux.scope: Full recorded native render loop; every scheduling readback verified; independent original-CPU film
